Your number of mistakes can affect your tamagotchi\'s next evolution!
Engage in puzzles to boost your Tamagotchi\'s intelligence. Building high intelligence can reduce your mistakes!
Reach your fitness goals to build fitness, maintaining a high fitness can redeem mistakes!
Turn the lights out for your Tamagotchi when it goes to sleep!
Clean your tamagotchi when it is dirty. Leaving your tamagotchi unclean for too long can result in sickness!
"Heal your tamagotchi to cure sickness.\nIf your tamagotchi is sick too long it will register a mistake or even die! "
Every so often your Tamagotchi will evolve to a new stage
Values like your tamagotchi\'s discipline or the number of mistakes you\'ve made affect which form your tamagotchi will evolve to!
Your tamagotchi may die if you make too many mistakes or it is sick for too long.
